exactSubmittedPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make a NEW independent youthful avatar of Chihaya Anon (MyGO!!!!!), square 1024 x 1024, genuinely transparent background. This is an original personal moment for 在场, not an anime-canon scene. The supplied current 2D portrait is ONLY an identity guide for long pink hair, separated bangs and her recognizable gray-blue eyes. Its long-face tendencies and previous large open-mouth smile are NOT a proportional or expression target. Do not crop a body/room picture or paste any existing face.

She has just found a small idea she genuinely likes and is about to share it with someone familiar. Her eyes are bright with specific expectation: the gaze meets the viewer as if checking whether they see the same amusing possibility. A very slight lift at one brow, a visible small warm smile beginning at one mouth corner, lips gently parted just enough to suggest she might speak, no broad tooth display. Keep her lively confidence and a trace of wanting the idea to be appreciated, not a generic service smile, blank puppy stare, forced wink, huge laugh or sad timid face. No props, captions, stars or speech bubbles are needed to explain the feeling.

Draw a softly SHORT, youthful cheek-and-chin relationship, natural full young cheeks turning into a short gently rounded chin, and a compact middle/lower face. Preserve Anon's own restrained eye shape and normal eye-to-nose-to-mouth relations; do not solve youth by giant glass eyes, infant cheeks, a tiny chibi nose, squeezing the whole skull or scaling the forehead. NO adult vertical long jaw, sharp mature glamour chin, long exposed neck, heavy fashion lashes, makeup or lipstick. Fine natural lips and small nose, distinct thoughtful gray-blue irises. It should read as the same smart young girl, personally pleased and ready to listen, not a baby or adult model.

Pink long hair is softly separated and layered, with natural airy bangs and readable side locks, subtle hand-painted warm/cool planes, no plastic shine or solid helmet. No invented bow, ribbon, cat ears or other character's accessories. The long hair may continue naturally below the bottom edge, but the complete crown, both eye regions and cheek-side hair needed for a circular closeup stay safely in frame. Delicate refined literary 2D linework with softly painted young skin, not photo realism, 3D figurine, glossy skin, plush or a room-background crop.

Head and hair occupy nearly all the square, friendly near-frontal orientation with only a small natural turn and less dramatic tilt than the old portrait. Leave only a tiny necessary neckline and hint of white shirt collar / gray-violet blazer at the lower edge, perhaps a small dark-green tie hint; do not spend the frame on a large torso or broad shoulders. Soft neutral flattering light, subtle natural cheek warmth, her actual pink hair and gray-blue eyes remain clear. No room, object, frame, circle border, label, watermark or colored backdrop. Real clean alpha transparency with fine hair edges, not painted checkerboard.
